notes: No maintained live-demo surface exists, so demo-action inventory is not applicable. Product source actions are recursively inventoried and must have a link, native form/dialog command, or Limen event binding. Focused outcome assertions and existing end-to-end workflows prove critical action effects, refusals, recovery, keyboard operation, and print/PDF behavior. No application-specific layout or action defect reproduced at the pinned Forma 0.9.0 and Folio 0.4.0 baselines.
